(F10)Problem solving and decision-making became increasingly more difficult for most farmers with interpersonal conflict and relationship breakdown becoming salient acute stressors prior to death. Farmers largely coped with relationship stress and breakup alone (eg, did not seek legal or financial advice, did not seek help from relatives or friends), engaged in impulsive behaviors (eg, sold stock, machinery), and increased consumption of alcohol and cannabis.
